about_full.journey_subheading: Bringing ordinary people together to make extraordinary things happen.
about_full.heading: Who is Sam Johnson?
about_full.subheading: Sam Johnson is a Civic Entrepreneur - a career focused on identifying opportunities that create value for society and enhance common well-being.
about_full.journey_heading: From Christchurch to the Global Stage
about_full.today_intro: Sam is the Projects Director at STILL, a family office venture founded by Hideaki Fukutake. Through STILL, he works on projects that amplify the fundamentals of human nature, with a focus on people, nature, arts, and culture.
about_full.origin_intro: In February 2011, a devastating earthquake struck Christchurch. Sam Johnson was a university student watching his city break apart while thousands of young people were being told to stay out of the way. He disagreed.
about_full.quote: Young people aren't the leaders of tomorrow. Given a shovel and some trust, they are the leaders of right now.

values.title: Ordinary People. Extraordinary Things.
values.body: Given trust and something real to do, ordinary people do extraordinary things. Sam has watched it happen more than 80,000 times over.

values.title: Doing Good Projects With Good People
values.body: The best work happens shoulder to shoulder — building things that matter, with people who care.

values.title: See the Opportunity
values.body: Every challenge hides an invitation. Optimism is a discipline: find the opening, then move.
